title: Director, Corporate Communications
description:
Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.

With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.

The Opportunity

Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.

Role Overview

As a Director in Teneo Strategy & Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.

Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.

This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.

title: Senior Consultant, Financial Advisory
description:
The Role

This is an excellent opportunity to join Teneo’s well established Financial Advisory team in Cardiff. You will work alongside experienced practitioners advising the management teams, lenders and shareholders of businesses that are underperforming and/or facing any financial challenges.

The Cardiff team delivers complex, high-profile advisory and formal insolvency appointments, both locally and nationally and across a range of sectors. As a Senior Consultant, you will be exposed to a variety of projects in areas such as debt advisory, accelerated M&A, insolvency, performance improvement and financial forecasting.

As a Senior Consultant, you will contribute to a range of projects including restructuring, insolvency, financial forecasting and transaction support. You will take responsibility for delivering key pieces of analysis, while continuing to develop your technical and client-facing skills.

The position encourages growth and career development, with a clear path of progression. You will develop a broad skill set across financial modelling, report writing, and stakeholder management, as well as being involved with business development activities that will build your network.

You will primarily be based in our Cardiff office, with opportunities to work at client sites and collaborate with colleagues across other locations.

Key Responsibilities

Client Service

On a day-to-day basis, you will be a key team member working on financial restructuring and insolvency engagements. With guidance, your role will include:

  • Lead discrete workstreams on restructuring and insolvency assignments
  • Produce clear, high-quality client deliverables that inform key decisions
  • Analyse financial performance and support the development of forecasts

title: Management Consulting, Senior Manager - Agentic AI
description:
Key Attributes 

As a Senior Manager, you’ll be an accomplished and effective member of the Teneo Consulting team, leading client engagements with the support of Directors and Managing Directors, developing junior colleagues, and bringing a strong understanding of how data, AI and emerging technology can create measurable business value. 

 

You will operate at pace, demonstrate ownership and sound judgement, and be comfortable influencing and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. You will combine strong attention to detail with the ability to see the bigger picture, ensuring analysis and recommendations are rigorous, well-structured and executive-ready. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Structure and lead projects or major workstreams of complex engagements, working directly with a Director or Managing Director and taking day-to-day ownership of delivery, team performance and client outcomes

title: Talent Acquisition and People Ops Resourcer
description:
Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach. 

Our concept, “Technology, done differently”, embodies our belief that the way our customers consume and utilize technology should innovate at the same pace as the technology itself.

Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. From designing, deploying and managing infrastructure stacks within low-latency financial trading environments, to relocating the headquarters of a global fintech firm, our operations span multiple markets, industries and geographies.

Techary have helped customers scale their operations globally, gain an advantage in financial markets, enabled mission-critical projects and, most importantly, implemented technology that delivers alpha-accelerating business transformation.

 

The Role

 

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition (TA) and People Operations Resourcer to join our fast-growing talent team. Techary has more than doubled in size since 2024, and with 50+ hires to make, you will be at the heart of our next stage of growth. You will be the first voice candidates hear from us, running screening calls, keeping Greenhouse in shape and sourcing for our harder-to-fill roles. You will also support people operations with administration tasks and learn our HR processes as you go.

Success in this role comes from a full diary of calls every week, a high share of your shortlists reaching second interview, and close collaboration with hiring managers.
